description: Address 6 review issues: wire _stream_output, fix callback routing, bound _recent_changes, isolate subscriber exceptions, document advisory locking, fix ConditionBuilder docstring
steps: Issue #1: Wire _stream_output into _do_execute when is_interactive is True as a background task
Issue #2: Remove first-match fallback in _handle_callback_result - require session_id in payload
Issue #3: Add max_recent_changes parameter to KnowledgePlaza.__init__ with default 1000 and prune in notify_subscribers
Issue #4: Wrap each callback invocation in try/except in notify_subscribers, log failures
Issue #5: Add docstring notes to lock_page and update_page explaining advisory locking
Issue #6: Fix ConditionBuilder docstring to clarify each method replaces the expression
acceptance_criteria: Full test suite still passes (2260+ tests)
New tests cover the behavioral changes
